01
Applications & Platforms
Mobile apps, web platforms, and digital products built for real-world use.
アプリ・プラットフォーム
6 sub-services
·
47 projects
We design and build digital products that work in the real world. From consumer-facing mobile apps and data-driven web platforms to internal tools that transform how teams operate, our development practice covers the full product lifecycle: discovery, architecture, build, and launch. We work across industries including media, enterprise, geospatial, and creative sectors.
01.01
Mobile Applications
Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android, built for performance, usability, and long-term maintainability.
+28
01.02
Web Platforms and SaaS
Scalable web applications and platforms engineered for growth, from MVPs to complex multi-tenant systems.
+2
01.03
Business & Operational Tools
Custom internal tools, dashboards, and workflow systems designed to streamline how organisations operate.
01.04
Geospatial Applications
Location-aware applications and mapping tools that turn spatial data into actionable, intuitive experiences.
+5
01.05
Web Pages
Branded web pages and marketing sites designed to engage audiences and communicate your story.
01.06
Digital Twins
High-fidelity digital replicas of physical systems and environments, enabling simulation, analysis, and real-time monitoring.
02
Games & Interactive Media
Game development and interactive media across mobile, PC, console, and emerging platforms.
ゲーム・インタラクティブ
5 sub-services
·
19 projects
We create games and interactive experiences that reach players across every platform. Whether developing original IP, porting titles to new platforms, or providing co-development support, our team brings deep technical expertise and a passion for craft to every project. We handle the full spectrum, from early prototyping and game technology R&D to shipped, polished products.
02.01
Original Game Development
Full-cycle development of original game titles, from concept and design through to ship and post-launch support.
+1
02.02
Game Porting
Bringing games to new platforms with native performance, platform compliance, and a seamless player experience.
02.03
Co-Development and Game Outsourcing
Embedded development support for studios, working as an extension of your team on features, systems, and content.
+4
02.04
Game Prototyping
Rapid prototyping to validate mechanics, explore concepts, and de-risk development before full production begins.
+1
02.05
Game Technology
Custom engine features, tools, pipelines, and technology R&D that give your game a technical edge.
03
AI & Intelligent Systems
Design and integration of AI-powered features, tools, and workflows within digital products.
AI・インテリジェント
4 sub-services
·
3 projects
We design and integrate AI-powered systems into digital products, combining large language models, automation, and data pipelines to enhance capabilities. From embedding AI into existing platforms to building intelligent features from scratch, we ensure systems are reliable, scalable, and aligned with real-world use cases.
03.01
AI Integration
Integration of AI services such as LLMs, generative tools, and automation workflows into existing systems and applications.
03.02
AI-Enhanced Applications
Development of applications and features that leverage AI to improve user experience, functionality, and decision-making.
03.03
AI System Stabilisation
Diagnosis, optimisation, and maintenance of AI-integrated systems to ensure performance, reliability, and consistency in production environments.
03.04
AI Pipeline Development
Design and implementation of data and model pipelines, including workflows for retrieval, processing, and generation.
04
XR & Experiential Technology
XR applications and immersive experiences for both physical spaces and home platforms.
XR・体験技術
3 sub-services
·
25 projects
We build immersive experiences that blur the line between digital and physical. Our XR practice covers AR, VR, and mixed reality applications for both consumer platforms and bespoke installations. From permanent exhibition spaces to live events and activations, we design and engineer experiences that leave lasting impressions.
04.01
XR Applications
AR, VR, and mixed reality applications for mobile, headset, and browser, from utility tools to immersive entertainment.
+9
04.02
Interactive Installations & Exhibitions
Custom interactive systems for museums, galleries, public spaces, and brand environments.
+7
04.03
Live & Event Experiences
Real-time interactive experiences for live events, activations, and performances, designed to surprise and engage audiences.
05
Backend & Platform Engineering
Backend architecture, integrations, and performance optimisation for complex digital systems.
バックエンド・基盤
3 sub-services
·
24 projects
We architect and maintain the backend systems that power complex digital products. Our engineering team specialises in scalable infrastructure, third-party integrations, and performance-critical systems. We also take on rescue projects, stepping in to stabilise, debug, and modernise platforms that need expert attention.
05.01
Backend Systems & Infrastructure
API design, cloud infrastructure, database architecture, and system integrations for resilient, scalable platforms.
+5
05.02
Performance Optimisation
Profiling, benchmarking, and targeted engineering to make your systems faster, leaner, and more reliable.
+5
05.03
Technical Debugging and Rescue Projects
Rapid diagnosis and remediation for critical issues, taking on complex, urgent problems that require deep technical experience.
+7
